field_text_formatted.value: Press Preview, and the module fills in the template's tokens and frames the page on the Frontend tab. Beside it, Drupal is core's own preview, for anything Drupal renders itself, and JSON:API is the raw document: the tab I open first when a field doesn't turn up.
